Subject: RE: Brenvale Warehousing - New Submission

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the Brenvale Warehousing submission! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I have a few questions before I can finalize terms:

- Can you provide details on the fire protection systems at each location (sprinklers, alarms, monitoring)?
- What are the primary commodities stored at each warehouse?
- Are there any tenants, or is this owner-occupied only?
- What security measures are in place (cameras, guards, fencing)?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for the 12/17/26 effective date.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best,
[Underwriter name]
